A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Dense-SfM and contain complete, readable main text and supplementary Sections 7–10. Text, equations, tables, and rendered figures support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original triangulation, camera-pose estimation, ablation, runtime, and novel-view synthesis results in the main text and supplement.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results and reports additional MASt3R-SfM comparisons in Tables 1–2.

M1.justification: Dense matching, Gaussian Splatting track extension, multi-view kernelized refinement, training losses, and bundle adjustment remain unchanged, including the supplementary method details.

E1.justification: Both versions retain MegaDepth training and ETH3D, Texture-Poor SfM, IMC 2021, and LLFF evaluations. The additional comparator results introduce no dataset, task, or test-scenario coverage.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 relabel the existing MASt3R-SfM rows, with and without refinement, as MASt3R + COLMAP while retaining their scores. Each table adds a separate MASt3R-SfM comparator row; the other comparator memberships are unchanged.

E3.justification: The reported protocols remain unchanged, including fixed-pose triangulation on 13 ETH3D scenes, pose evaluation coverage, thresholds, and supplementary settings. The January 2026 result-update footnotes specify no changed evaluation procedure.

E4.justification: Matching, refinement-component, and iteration ablations remain unchanged in Table 3. Supplementary sparse/semi-dense matching comparisons, refinement analyses, runtime comparisons, and track-length analysis are also retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without experimental repeat-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The new comparator rows follow the existing reporting practice.

E6.justification: Changes are confined to new MASt3R-SfM results in Tables 1–2; existing scores remain unchanged after matching renamed rows. Table 1 gains a completeness leader: MASt3R-SfM reports 14.86/34.81/68.72%, versus RoMa + Ours at 7.38/17.06/36.35%, at 1/2/5 cm, although its triangulation accuracy is lower.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, visibility calculation, Gaussian Process formulation, refinement loss, bundle-adjustment objective, and supplementary Gaussian-scale formula are unchanged. No proofs or formal assumptions are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about dense, accurate reconstruction and leading performance. These claims are not narrowed following the additional baseline results.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are unchanged. Section 10 retains the limitations concerning photometric variation and transient occlusions; no discussion is added about MASt3R-SfM's newly reported completeness advantage.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, hardware, runtime disclosures, Gaussian training details, and the project-access link remain unchanged. The new baseline results are dated January 2026 but receive no additional configuration or execution details.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and cited-work set are unchanged. Tables 1–2 attach the already-cited MASt3R reference [30] to the relabeled COLMAP rows, without expanding the literature discussion or revising the novelty argument.

P1.justification: Editorial changes comprise comparator naming, two result-update footnotes, and the version/date stamp. Main prose, section organization, and supplementary narrative remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Tables 1–2 gain a comparator row and revised labels, with small scaling, spacing, and page-flow adjustments accommodating the footnotes. Figures and the remaining tables retain their content.

improvement.justification: Distinguishing MASt3R + COLMAP from MASt3R-SfM and supplying separate results makes Tables 1–2 more transparent and informative. The improvement is limited: Section 4.3 retains broad superiority wording without addressing MASt3R-SfM's substantially higher completeness, leaving the interpretation insufficiently qualified.
